channel.title: Business Insider Africa - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Business Insider Africa (africa.businessinsider.com)

item.title: Nigeria touts a $2.5 billion plan to end its electricity problems
item.description: The persistent and detrimental issue of Nigeria's power sector is currently being addressed with a significant government intervention aimed at resolving the perennial blackouts that plague the nation.

item.title: From structural adjustments to resource takeover, inside Mali’s bold fight for its gold
item.description: Mali's Gold has traditionally been considered more than just a resource. Today, it serves as a strategic asset and geopolitical tool, influencing national policy, international investment, and political decision-making.

item.title: DR Congo set to export 100,000 tons of copper from Chinese-run mines to the United States
item.description: The Democratic Republic of Congo has confirmed plans to ship 100,000 metric tons of copper from a Chinese-run mine to the United States by the end of January, following its submission to the U.S. administration of a list of state-backed mining projects for potential investment

item.title: Canal+ forecasts $479 million in annual synergies by 2030 after $3 billion MultiChoice acquisition
item.description: French media group Canal+ has outlined significant cost-saving expectations from its $3 billion acquisition of South African pay-TV operator MultiChoice, sending its shares to record highs on Thursday, January 29, 2026.

item.title: Nigeria turns to Turkey for investment and security support in $5bn mega deal
item.description: Nigeria has signed a series of trade and security agreements with Turkey aimed at lifting bilateral commerce to $5bn and strengthening cooperation on defence, as President Bola Tinubu intensifies efforts to attract foreign investment and stabilise Africa’s largest economy.

item.title: Even as gold hits record highs, Ghana is quietly ditching its gold for foreign currency
item.description: Ghana, whose economic resurgence last year was largely driven by the strong performance of gold, made the surprising decision to significantly cut down its gold reserves.

item.title: Top 10 biggest agrifoodtech deals in Africa
item.description: According to AgFunder’s recent Developing Markets AgriFoodTech Investment report, Kenya, Egypt, and Nigeria continue to dominate Africa’s agrifoodtech landscape.

item.title: U.S opens communications with AES bloc as Sahel insecurity deepens
item.description: The United States has quietly maintained channels of communication with the militaries of the Alliance of Sahel States (AES) which includes Mali, Niger and Burkina Faso despite the formal breakdown of security cooperation following military coups in the region.

item.title: Top 10 African country with the highest gold and foreign exchange reserves at the start of 2026
item.description: In Africa, Libya leads with $92.9 billion in foreign exchange and gold reserves, ranking 31st globally.

item.title: US returns to Africa with investment-first strategy as competition for influence intensifies
item.description: The United States is recalibrating its Africa engagement around an investment-first strategy as competition for economic and geopolitical influence on the continent sharpens.
